records.newText: Skills don't level up by themselves: you spend points, and each skill level also needs a character level. Skill level L opens at the level you learned the skill + 3 × (L − 2). Cold Shock, learned at Lv 1, reaches skill level 5 at Lv 10. Each level costs 1 point (levels 2–4), 2 points (5–7) or 4 points (8–10).
records.note: The Assassin guide's claim C02, with the Spiritmaster's Cold Shock as the example (learned at Lv 1, Metabot). The rule is the game's (rule:skill-level-gate, rule:skill-point-cost); the owner's screens are from an Assassin. Three Spiritmaster passives (Spirit Communion, Revitalization Contract, Element Unification) have a flat gate instead: every level opens when the skill is learned.
